description: This script computes global objects based on WebIDL interface definitions, identifying interfaces with [Global] or [PrimaryGlobal] attributes, and outputs a pickle file with interface names and their global identifiers.

methods.name: parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for input files and output filename.

methods.name: idl_file_to_global_names
methods.description: Extracts global names from an IDL file based on extended attributes.

methods.name: idl_files_to_interface_name_global_names
methods.description: Yields pairs of interface names and their global names from a list of IDL files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the reading, processing, and writing of global object data.
